title: RC16 All-Slot Evaluation Clock Shape

research_height.transfer_path: The unchanged RC16 micro signal is observed at every available M30 clock slot; its slot-wide eight-bar response and component-local non-overlap starts determine whether the current once-daily clock can plausibly transmit into the portfolio's missing daily turnover before any full-portfolio intervention is considered.

central_question: When the unchanged long-only RC16 range-compression signal is evaluated at every available US30 M30 decision bar rather than only 13:30, is its eight-bar market response broadly positive and sufficiently clock-diffuse across both 2025 and completed 2026 months to justify one later full-portfolio real-tick all-slot candidate?

research_bundle.name: full_clock_shape_then_component_local_capacity_transmission
lenses: mechanism: the full supported M30 slot curve of ATR-normalized eight-bar forward return and maximum adverse excursion
transmission: greedy component-local non-overlap starts per eligible day versus the native 13:30 signal clock
falsification: native-slot concentration, four fixed clock quadrants and independent 2025 versus completed-month 2026 shape consistency

why_now.current_bottleneck: The portfolio's historical average first-fill rate is about 2.14 per normal day versus a binding target of 3.0, while RC16 evaluates an M30-computable feature only once at 13:30. The actual information value is whether the clock broadly preserves the signal, not which neighboring minute looks best.
why_now.connection_bridge: A broad all-slot shape could create at least the missing 0.86 lifecycle-starting opportunities per day before portfolio admission; a native-only shape would show that the binding RC16 result is inseparable from its clock. Either result changes whether a later portfolio intervention is worth implementing.
why_now.perspective_distance: Units 061 and 062 were Program 5 macro-admission and micro stop/lot questions and both closed invalid. Unit 063 moves to Program 3, begins at the meso decision clock, uses direct bar-path observations rather than account-risk reconstruction or MQL intervention, and tests pre-entry opportunity creation.
why_now.difference_from_prior_program_3: Unit 056 conditioned realized entries on incumbent or flat handoff and Unit 047 compared Monday and Friday entry states. Unit 063 changes neither admission nor a calendar subgroup: it observes one frozen signal over the complete clock surface before any trade exists.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one later, separately declared, full-portfolio real-tick RC16 all-slot candidate using every supported slot and the unchanged signal/hold contract. Unit 063 itself selects no time and authorizes no EA or Live change.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the 13:30 clock and close the all-slot expansion without selecting a favorable time subset, changing the signal threshold/window, or rescuing a session.
why_now.decision_if_invalid_or_sparse: Record an observation gap or invalid reconstruction and retain no candidate. Do not repair the same family or infer a clock conclusion.

data_role_and_acquisition.role: Selection on complete 2025 clock shape plus temporal confirmation on completed 2026 months. This is market-path observation only, not trade or portfolio outcome evidence.
data_role_and_acquisition.runtime_copy_scope: One independent physical minimal Portable containing terminal support, Config and only the required US30 history/symbol scope; no junction, link, Tester cache, report tree, other-family executable or Live dependency.
data_role_and_acquisition.acquisition_method: One MetaTrader5 Python API copy_rates_range call for US30 TIMEFRAME_M30 through the dedicated Portable; permitted methods are initialize, symbol_select, copy_rates_range, last_error and shutdown only.
data_role_and_acquisition.time_contract: Use the terminal bar epoch exactly as returned and format it without a timezone remap. The 151-row 13:30 candidate-ledger parity gate determines whether that clock contract matches the frozen EA.

frozen_reconstruction.information_set: At evaluation bar i, use exactly the 112 completed available M30 bars i-112 through i-1. Entry proxy is open[i]; no current-bar high, low or close enters the signal.
frozen_reconstruction.normal_range: Exact median of the 96 prior range samples, averaging the two central sorted values.
frozen_reconstruction.current_range: The log high-low range of completed-bar indices 96 through 111.
frozen_reconstruction.signed_tightness: sign(direction_return) divided by current_range/normal_range; exactly zero when direction_return is zero.
frozen_reconstruction.atr: ATR14 from the fourteen completed bars immediately before evaluation, using true range against the preceding completed close and an arithmetic mean.
frozen_reconstruction.forward_return_atr: (open[i+8] - open[i]) / ATR14_at_i, using the eighth next available M30 bar open.
frozen_reconstruction.mae_atr: max(0, open[i] - min(low[i:i+8])) / ATR14_at_i over the entry bar through the bar immediately before exit.
frozen_reconstruction.clock_slot: HH:MM of each actually available evaluation bar; no absent slot is synthesized.
frozen_reconstruction.eligible_day: A calendar date within the period with at least one valid evaluation bar after all warmup and forward-horizon requirements; zero-signal eligible days remain in daily-rate denominators.
frozen_reconstruction.component_local_nonoverlap: Sort all qualifying signals chronologically. Accept the first and suppress later signals until index i+8; a signal at exactly i+8 may start. This is an RC16-only capacity shadow and does not reconstruct portfolio admission.

fixed_integrity_gate: Declaration commit is pushed before runtime copy, MT5 initialization, bar export or any forward return.
The three canonical HCC inputs and candidate ledger retain exact bytes and SHA-256 before and after acquisition; the dedicated runtime may synchronize only its own copy.

Export has the exact declared columns, finite positive OHLC, high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), nonnegative volumes/spread, unique strictly increasing epoch and no row at or after the exclusive acquisition boundary.

Every reconstructed candidate-ledger-known RC16 decision through July matches one exported 13:30 evaluation, all 151 feature values within absolute 1e-10 and all 151 pass flags exactly; there are zero extra joins, missing joins or duplicate known bars.
No forward-return, MAE, slot mean, daily rate or candidate gate is emitted before all input and parity checks pass.

fixed_density_gate.supported_nonnative_slot_definition: At least ten qualifying signals in each period for the same nonnative HH:MM slot.

fixed_broad_shape_gate.pooled_value: Nonnative mean forward_return_atr is strictly positive in both periods.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.typical_slot: Median supported-nonnative-slot mean forward_return_atr is strictly positive in both periods.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.slot_breadth: At least 60 percent of supported nonnative slots have positive mean forward_return_atr in each period.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.quadrant_breadth: At least three of four fixed quadrant means are positive in each period.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.native_not_unique: When native 13:30 mean is positive, nonnative pooled mean is at least 0.75 times native in that period; when native mean is nonpositive, the strictly positive nonnative pooled requirement is sufficient.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.temporal_stability: Absolute difference between the two periods' nonnative pooled mean forward_return_atr is no more than 0.20 ATR.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.adverse_path: Nonnative median mae_atr is no more than native median mae_atr plus 0.25 ATR in each period.
fixed_broad_shape_gate.slot_concentration: No single supported nonnative slot contributes more than 20 percent and the top four contribute no more than 50 percent of total positive supported-slot forward-return sum in either period.

fixed_capacity_transmission_gate.incremental_over_native_signals_per_elig: All-slot non-overlap starts minus native 13:30 qualifying signals is at least 0.86 per eligible day in each period.
fixed_capacity_transmission_gate.interpretation_limit: Passing indicates opportunity capacity only. It does not establish fills, costs, coexistence with current positions, shared-slot feasibility, portfolio P/L or drawdown.

fixed_verdict_rules.success: PASS_BROAD_RC16_ALL_SLOT_CLOCK_SHAPE_RETAIN_ONE_PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE only when integrity, density, broad-shape and capacity-transmission gates all pass in both periods.
fixed_verdict_rules.valid_failure: NO_BROAD_RC16_ALL_SLOT_CLOCK_SHAPE when integrity and density pass but any broad-shape or capacity-transmission requirement fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.insufficient_density: INSUFFICIENT_RC16_ALL_SLOT_DENSITY_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes but any density requirement fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_RC16_ALL_SLOT_DATA_OR_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any immutable input, acquisition, schema, bar, time or 151-row parity gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_RC16_ALL_SLOT_CLOCK_SHAPE_NO_CANDIDATE only when all declared integrity conditions pass but an unforeseen semantic condition prevents applying the frozen gates.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration, README, retention receipt, Frontier memory and state before creating the dedicated runtime or opening bar-path outcomes.
If runtime initialization or acquisition produces no usable output, one acquisition-only correction is allowed before any metric; otherwise no second acquisition.
Run immutable-input and 151-row feature parity checks before forward-return construction. Failure closes invalid without a metric rerun or data-source substitution.
After the first successful fixed aggregation emits any forward metric, make no correction or rerun. Close with the observed valid, invalid, sparse or ambiguous verdict.
Do not select a time, inspect a favorable subgroup as a rescue, change any threshold/window/hold/ATR rule, simulate portfolio admission, implement an EA or touch Live.
Freeze family and evidence, minimally update state, commit and push, then recompare the whole question map before the remaining Cross proposal.
